headlines.title: Starbucks weighs sale of Japan business worth several billion dollars - Bloomberg
headlines.summary: Investing.com-- Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has hired advisers including Citigroup (NYSE:C) and Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) to explore a potential sale of its Japan business, which could be valued at several billion dollars, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Starbucks Is Said to Engage Banks for Sale of Japan Business
headlines.summary: Starbucks Corp. has tapped advisers to prepare for a potential sale of its Japan business for several billion dollars, according to people familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Starbucks to Participate in the 2026 Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference
headlines.summary: SEATTLE, November 24, 2026--Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that Cathy Smith, evp, chief financial officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference on Wednesday, December 2nd, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. Eastern Time.

headlines.title: Who is holding Jensen Huang accountable? It sure looks like nobody
headlines.summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi digs into day two of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Including a Financial Times report that interim CEO Colette Kress was left out of the talks to bring Huang back, a Wall Street Journal report that Huang disclosed more affairs to the board than previously known, why Brian says Nvidia is effectively a "board of one," and what history says about returning founders from Steve Jobs and Howard Schultz to Kevin Plank.

headlines.title: Colgate-Palmolive vs. Starbucks: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Colgate's steady oral care and pet business meets Starbucks' sprawling coffeehouse empire, and their risks and valuations diverge sharply.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
